messages:
Maya: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp failing on rerank+embeds. Go batcher shows 1536, python prints 1537 then server 400s.
Sam: Any request/response dumps?
Maya: scrubbed payload: {\"embedding\": {\"dim\":1537, \"vector_length\":1536, \"values\": [...]}} — both keys present and disagree.
Chen: Aha. Go-sdk writes vector_length from internal buffer calc, py sets dim from len(values). We serialize both.
Olivia: Also noticed auth refresh retries around same time — could reslice mutate buffer on retry and leave an extra slot?
Maya: Two identical value arrays but conflicting metadata, so values are same. Metadata divergence is the issue.
Sam: Immediate unblock: patch sampleapp to stop sending vector_length and only send dim.
Chen: Longer fix: server should canonicalize dim = len(values) and return clear error like \"declared dim X != actual len Y\". I'll open a go-sdk PR to remove vector_length and add an assertion in the batcher.
sdk-bot: Created INF-4123: \"embedding shape parity: dim vs vector_length\" and linked SDK teams.
deploy-bot: Canary pipeline updated with shape-validation guard (pipeline #6790).
Olivia: Add e2e to devex harness to run both SDKs against shape-validator to catch regressions.
Maya: Filed repro & failing test in sampleapp. Will paste PR links here once ready.
Sam: Thanks for quick triage — prioritize server guard + small SDK changes.
